capabilities: Expose an MCP server endpoint (/second-brain-mcp/) through the Local REST API plugin
Find relevant entry-point notes via semantic search with local embedding models
Traverse outgoing links and backlinks breadth-first to gather surrounding context
Provide MCP tools (query_wiki, get_wiki, wiki_card) for agentic workflows
Cache embeddings locally for faster subsequent queries
disambiguation: Despite the "Second Brain" name, it is not a knowledge-management workflow plugin; it only serves vault content to LLMs over MCP.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Offers two builds: a standard pure-JavaScript single-core build and a native build with pre-compiled C++ binaries that must be installed manually from GitHub Releases for multi-core indexing.
intentEvidence: This plugin is an extension (or "meta-plugin") for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin.
problem: Obsidian's Local REST API only exposes raw file CRUD endpoints, so LLMs must dump whole files into context instead of retrieving relevant, interconnected notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is an extension (or "meta-plugin") for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin.

summary: Extension for the Local REST API plugin that adds an MCP server giving LLMs semantic, graph-based access to vault notes.
